verdicts.reason: Both break the TUE/WED/THU list into fragments: TUE sits at far left, WED under the headline and THU beside the logo. TUE and THU are tiny, almost unreadable text, and the logo's GALLERY line disappears. A is worse because the WED row is set much larger than TUE and THU, so the list has inconsistent sizes and the row competes with the headline, and it is jammed against 'All free, all at 19:00.' B at least keeps all three rows the same size and leaves space between WED and the subline.
